limitations: Finite connected base graphs; finitely many connected covering components; componentwise-constant weights; at most two extreme Markov operators. General m, base-dependent weights, infinite coverings and arbitrary bases excluded.
scientific_integrity: Proof supplied for exact two-map, operator-norm formulas. Finite exact-rational checks are corroborative, not a proof of the topological coverage lemma. Publication priority and independent validation have not been established.
title: Exact two-map approximation of componentwise-weighted disconnected covering averages
